resources.string: WARE uses Shizuku so the console can administer this phone: screen, apps, files, processes, logs, and shell.
Connecting grants the console full admin of this handset until you disconnect.
Paste the address and pairing code shown on the WARE console.
Shizuku is not running. Install it, start it, then tap Grant access.
Tap Grant access and approve the Shizuku prompt.
Shizuku is granted. Connect to the console next.
Could not reach the console. Check the address and that the site is public.
Enter the console address and pairing code.
